brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.evidence: Three hex bases at 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 0,-1,0 with top covers and end caps, forming portable organizer platform
Three lift-out bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 – each 2-compartment full-depth trays for screws/standoffs etc.
notch:0#-1,0#notch0 = hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf drawer frame between cells -1,0 and 0,0
handle:0,0,0;top mounted on central cover (0,0,0) with insert reinforcements

finish.summary: Portable L-shaped 3-cell base with covers, capped edges, locked joints, three removable 2-compartment bins for small electronics parts, one notch drawer, and central top carry handle. Staged with small-parts props in bins.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
